shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- App ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- routing entry ---'; rg -n -A18 -B4 'date-components|date-utils' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -100; printf '%s\\n' '--- local docs ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components 2>/dev/null || true; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -maxdepth 3 -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -iname 'README.md' 2>/dev/null | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json > /tmp/package.json.bak && npm install --save @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils && printf '\\n--- versions ---\\n' && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) console.log(p, require(p+'/package.json').version)\" && printf '\\n--- setup/readme ---\\n' && (rg -n -A35 -B5 'Required setup|Getting started|Installation|Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -180 || true) && printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n' && (rg -n 'Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true)"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3 version peerDependencies --json && printf '\\n--- majors ---\\n' && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -60 && printf '\\n--- uikit major ---\\n' && npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@7 version --json | tail -20"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --save @gravity-ui/date-components@3.4.2 @gravity-ui/date-utils@''^2.6.0 && printf '"'\\n--- versions ---\\n' && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) console.log(p, require(p+'/package.json').version)\" && printf '\\n--- setup/readme ---\\n' && (rg -n -A35 -B5 'Required setup|Getting started|Installation|Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -220 || true) && printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n' && (rg -n 'Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120 || true)"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) { const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/'+p+'/package.json')); console.log(p,j.version)}\"; printf '\\n--- docs files ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -maxdepth 3 \\( -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -iname 'README.md' \\) -print; printf '\\n--- setup/readme ---\\n'; rg -n -A30 -B5 'Required setup|Getting started|Installation|Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -220; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg -n 'Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist 2>/dev/null | head -140"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package setup ---'; node -e \"const j=require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json');const x=JSON.parse(j); console.log(JSON.stringify({exports:x.exports, peerDependencies:x.peerDependencies, dependencies:x.dependencies},null,2))\"; printf '%s\\n' '--- Calendar d.ts ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar -maxdepth 2 -name '*.d.ts' -print; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/index.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- Calendar props ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar -type f -name '*.d.ts' -exec rg -n 'interface|type .*Props|onUpdate|onValueChange|value|defaultValue|focusedValue|disabled|isDateUnavailable' {} +"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; printf '\\n--- state options ---\\n'; rg -n 'interface CalendarStateOptions|interface RangeCalendarStateOptions' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/*.d.ts -A45; printf '\\n--- Calendar js ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.js; printf '\\n--- readme setup grep ---\\n'; rg -n -A20 -B5 'setup|style|ThemeProvider|import' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md | head -180"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '20,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- base props ---\\n'; rg -n 'interface ValueBase|interface InputBase|onChange|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts -A18; printf '\\n--- date utils API ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils -maxdepth 3 -name '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg -n 'export declare function dateTime|export declare const dateTime|function parseDateTime|const parseDateTime' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,45p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/inputs.d.ts; printf '\\n--- date utils exports ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts; printf '\\n--- parse d.ts ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/parser.d.ts | head -100; printf '\\n--- package exports ---\\n'; node -e \"const x=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json')); console.log(JSON.stringify(x.exports,null,2))\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/common.d.ts; rg -n 'declare (function|const) (dateTime|parse)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build -g '*.d.ts' -A8; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json | head -80; rg -n 'loadLocale' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build -g '*.d.ts' -A4"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- package.json src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,220p'"
